The petitioners have filed these petitions U/s 166 of the Motor vehicles Act claiming compensation for the death of Babu S.R. and injuries to Maruthi D.N. in a motor vehicle accident that occurred on 13.2.2021.

The petition averments in brief are as under:

On 13.2.2021 at about 4.30 p.m., the deceased in MVC 2251-2021 was proceeding as a pillion rider in a bajaj Pulsar motor cycle bearing No. KA-51-HK-5119 and the said motor cycle was ridden by the petitioner in MVC 2252-2021 on the left side of NH-48, Bangalore- Tumkur road, near Bommanahalli, Kasaba Hobli, Nelamangala Taluk, Bangalore Rural District and at that time the driver of tanker lorry bearing No. KA-01-AG-5623 and Alto car bearing No. KA-03-MZ-6353 driven by its drivers in a rash and negligent manner and without giving any signal suddenly applied break, as a result, the rider of the motor cycle dashed to the back side of the alto car.
In MVC No. 2251-2021, due to the impact, the deceased sustained grievous injuries.

Immediately he was shifted to Swasthya Hospital, Kaveri Hospital and Sagar  SCCH-17 5 MVC No.2251& 2252/2021 Hospital, Bangalore and after seven days of the accident,
the deceased succumbed to the said injuries.
